Name: Fae Valley
Author: WhisperWillow
Description:
[center]Fae Valley

This mod makes almost all the characters in Stardew Valley into fae/monster creatures! This mod was inspired from the old Monster Valley mod, but it hasn't been updated since 2018 so this is my version (also why I am calling this mod Fae Valley so it isn't mixed up with the og one!) All the art for the portraits are my own, * character sprites were just edited from base game!﻿

Future Plans for this Mod
Eventually I want to add dialouge of characters making reference to them being a monster and stuff and like that and potentially edit gift tastes to more align with stuff like that
This mod will be updated for whatever is needed once 1.6 comes out (March 19th) but it may take some time depending on how many new assets I might have to draw so please keep this in mind!

(A few characters listed below have not been turned into monsters, mostly due to running out of ideas towards the end, but they have all still been given portraits in my style so everything is consistent! *The exception to this is korbus and the governer, for korbus because his portrait is just so cute and I haven't been able to do it justice in my own style, and for the gorverner because I do want to make him a monster/fae creature but I just don't know what exactly yet...)
